newsitem.title: USA: Milwaukee Land to acquire circuit board maker.
newsitem.headline: Milwaukee Land to acquire circuit board maker.

text.p: Milwaukee Land Co said Monday it agreed to acquire PG Design Electronics Inc, a Michigan-based manufacturer of printed circuit board assemblies and other products for computers.
Milwaukee Land, a closed-end investment company, said the purchase price is $15 million and includes the assumption of bank debt, currently estimated at $1.5 million.

"PG Design represents the culmination of an extensive search for an acquisition which would serve the interests of Milwaukee Land Company," said Edwin Jacobson, president of Milwaukee Land. "There is a good fit to the companies."

"This transaction will strengthen PG Design and allow us to continue to provide our customers with the products and service they need," said Peter VanHeusden, president of PG Design Electronics, in a statement.
PG Design Electronics had sales in fiscal 1996 of about $23 million and forecasts sales of about $30 million for fiscal 1997.

PG Design's 125 employees operate from a 25,000-square-foot manufacturing facility located in the metropolitan Detroit, Mich. area. VanHeusden will continue as president of PG Design Electronics, which will continue to be based in Chesterfield, Mich.
The acquisition requires approval of the transaction by Milwaukee Land's shareholders.
